about: At MediationWorks in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, Andrew Winston brings a wealth of experience as both a certified circuit civil mediator and a qualified arbitrator by the Supreme Court of Florida. His areas of proficiency include:

Since embarking on his legal journey in 1994, Mr. Winston has passionately served as a civil litigator and trial attorney. This extensive background grants him a unique perspective on the motivations that drive both plaintiffs and defendants. His keen insight enables him to swiftly comprehend the facts and nuances of each case, while his skill in connecting with all parties involved fosters collaboration and consensus, even in the most complex disputes.

Mr. Winston’s dedication to achieving excellence, coupled with his adeptness in alternative dispute resolution, has earned him a reputation as a respected mediator and arbitrator in Florida's legal community. With a track record of successful outcomes and a commitment to fair and efficient resolutions, he plays a pivotal role in shaping Florida's mediation and arbitration scene.

Originally from Philadelphia, Mr. Winston pursued his bachelor’s degree in sociology at Pennsylvania State University and graduated cum laude with honors from Temple University in 1990. He then obtained his J.D. from Nova Southeastern University Shepard Broad College of Law in 1994. He is authorized to practice law in all Florida courts, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit. His achievements have been recognized through numerous accolades, including membership in the Million Dollar Advocates Forum, a perfect 10.0 Avvo score and an AV Preeminent peer-review rating* through Martindale-Hubbell.

A distinguished presence in the legal community, Mr. Winston actively participates in The Florida Bar and the Broward County Bar Association (BCBA). He has served as co-chair of the Alternative Dispute Resolution Practice Section (2023-2024) and has been a member of the BCBA Bench and Bar committee since 2019.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
